subject: general
question: Seven people, I, J, K, L, O, P and Q are sitting in a row, facing north. Only three people sit between I and J. L sits to the immediate left of J. No one sits to the right of Q. Only two people sit between Q and L. K sits to the immediate right of P. How many people sit between O and K?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people, I, J, K, L, O, P and Q are sitting in a row, facing north.

No one sits to the right of Q.

Only three people sit between I and J.

L sits to the immediate left of J.

Only two people sit between Q and L.

K sits to the immediate right of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/414175c0dfec302e48165faa631e0d95599fb4bea0391c701f2a0dc670c43a06.png] 

Thus, Only two people sit between O and K.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
